typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOpicsFXVolumeDailyStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		PRODUCT as string,
		SPOTFWDIND as string,
		PORT as string,
		TRADEVOLUME as string,
		CURRENCYBASEAMOUNT as string,
		MONTH1 as string,
		YEAR as string,
		DEALDATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(Loaddate = toString(currentTimestamp())) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		TRADEVOLUME as integer,
		MONTH1 as string,
		PORT as string,
		YEAR as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		AsofDate as string,
		SPOTFWDIND as string,
		CURRENCYBASEAMOUNT as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TRADEVOLUME,
		MONTH1,
		PORT,
		YEAR,
		PRODUCT,
		Loaddate,
		AsofDate = DEALDATE,
		SPOTFWDIND,
		CURRENCYBASEAMOUNT),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOpicsFXVolumeDailyStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOpicsFXVolumeDailyStaging
